summary_en: Tokio Marine Holdings authorized the acquisition of up to 2.7 billion shares, or 9.6% of outstanding shares, for a maximum of 280 billion yen over the period from November 20, 2026 to April 30, 2027, to pursue flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 19, 2026, the board of directors of Tokio Marine Holdings resolved to acquire treasury shares under the authority granted by the company's articles of incorporation, in accordance with Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied by Article 165(3). The company is authorized to acquire up to 2.7 billion shares, representing 9.6% of outstanding shares (calculated on the basis of 28,056,997,870 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026), for an aggregate consideration not to exceed 280 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 20, 2026 through April 30, 2027. No specific acquisition price ceiling is disclosed. The stated purpose is to enable flexible execution of capital allocation policies. The disclosure does not specify the acquisition method, which may be determined during the authorization period.
